source: SPM 2026 Trial – WPKL – English Paper 2 · Part 2 · Question 2 · Essay (125–150 words)
paragraphs: Teenagers can play a meaningful role in society. One way teenagers can help is by volunteering at old folks' homes. Spending time with the elderly brings joy to lonely senior citizens. Furthermore, teenagers can help by taking part in gotong-royong to clean up their neighbourhood. A cleaner environment benefits everyone.

One benefit of community service is that it nurtures empathy in young people. By helping the less fortunate, students learn to count their blessings. Moreover, community service equips teenagers with valuable life skills. For example, organising a charity drive sharpens their leadership skills.

One way to encourage more teenagers to get involved in charity events is to give recognition to volunteers. Schools could award certificates or co-curricular merit points to students who volunteer. As a result, more students would be motivated to lend a helping hand. In a nutshell, every small act of kindness can make a big difference.
